review_candidates.description: Description You are a Superintendent, who will assume a leadership role by providing guidance to project staff and is responsible for the smooth functioning of day to day operations. Responsibilities will include safety and environmental, quality control, developing and implementing agreed upon field project plans and schedule, delegation of work to field staff, contractors and trades people ensuring that projects are completed on time and within budget. Click on the link below to see what it’s like working for Ledcor. Apply Now! Join our Technical Services team in Ontario today! Learn more about working at Ledcor: Watch here. Essential Responsibilities: Hire and manage hourly employees as required to complete the project in consultation with the Project Manager Ensure that site safety measures meet or exceed the parameters set out by corporate safety manual, Workers’ Compensation Board or any other authorities Ensure that projects are built according to approved plans, specifications, applicable building codes, and that efficiency in labour and materials maintain high quality standards Review, maintain and update the construction schedule and ensure milestone and completion dates are met Plan and execute system completion and system turnover Maintain, approve, and submit hourly digital timesheets with all necessary details for job costing and reporting purposes Prepare field change orders to be signed by project owner or representative when requested Review subtrade/supplier invoices against the field purchase orders and report any discrepancies to the Project Manager or the accounting department Manage the safety and performance of subtrade work Perform other related duties as assigned Qualifications: Certified Journeyperson Powerline Technician 15+ years of powerline construction experience and 5+ experience as a superintendent Combination of work experience in a similar role and industry related trade certification/education Experience on industrial / oil & gas, or mining projects and asset Understanding of industrial documents and the ability to ensure that they are complete, protect the owner’s interest, clearly define expectations and provide incentive to perform Knowledge of construction costs and budgets Strong safety record and the ability to work with a variety of individuals Ability to plan and manage a project schedule Able to focus on developing long term partnerships with key stakeholders to ensure our contributions to their continuing success Influence client and/or organizational leadership to accomplish operational objectives Anticipate problems or challenges, propose innovative solutions, and ensure solutions are consistent with project objectives Working Conditions: Site-based role, with a possible rotational shift depending on project location A living out allowance or accommodations will be provided. Travel allowances will be provided In between projects will be a mix of in-office work and work from home Compensation $112,000.00 - $154,000.00 This is the expected base pay range for this role. Individual base pay will be determined based on a variety of factors including experience, knowledge, skills, education and location. Our competitive total rewards package provides compensation and benefits that support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. We offer exciting, challenging work with opportunities to develop your skills and knowledge. review_candidates.title: Social Media Marketing Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description The company is a growing organization seeking to strengthen its digital presence and brand visibility. Based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, it serves a diverse audience and operates in a fast-paced, competitive market. The team values creativity, data-driven decision-making, and consistent engagement with online communities. Joining the organization offers the opportunity to contribute to impactful marketing initiatives and shape the company’s voice across social platforms. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates for a Social Media Marketing Specialist. The specialist will manage daily social media activities, including planning, creating, and publishing content across key platforms. Responsibilities include monitoring performance metrics, optimizing campaigns, responding to audience interactions, and maintaining a consistent brand voice. The role also involves collaborating with marketing and design teams to align social media initiatives with broader digital marketing strategies, supporting campaigns, promotions, and community-building efforts. Qualifications Strong skills in Social Media Marketing and Digital Marketing, with experience planning and executing campaigns across major platforms. Ability in Social Media Content Creation and Marketing, including developing engaging posts, visuals, and stories aligned with brand guidelines. Excellent Communication skills, with the capacity to adapt messaging to different audiences and channels. Proficiency in using social media analytics tools to track performance, generate reports, and optimize content and campaigns. Knowledge of current social media trends, best practices, and platform algorithms. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams such as design, sales, and customer support. Organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Previous experience in a social media or digital marketing role, preferably within the Dubai or broader GCC market, is an advantage.
